title: Cab takes over the band; who was in the Missourians
summary: In Philadelphia Cab tells the band he will take it over or hire another, so billing changes to Cab Calloway and His Orchestra; Thomas lists the Missourians' members.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Playing in Lionel Hampton's big band

blocks.x: Now, when did the band change to Cab's? You're still the Missourians as we...

Well, we was playing in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania. So Cab had got so big then, he was getting... He was getting to be the star of the band. So he called us all in a meeting. He said, 'Well, I'm going to either take over the band, or I'm gonna fire all you all and get me another band.' We was makin' more money, and we had never made that kind of money no way. So what's the big deal if he wanted to change it to Cab Calloway? See, it was first Cab Calloway and the Missourians. So he wanted to change it to Cab Calloway and His Orchestra, like all the other big shots. So we said... We agreed to let him take the band. We didn't want to get fired. We was makin' money, so...
Now, who is there? Lamar Wright was there...

Wheeler was there. DePriest was there. Because DePriest was the only one I could get the story of the band, how they got organized. It was a funny thing, they had all guys from Missouri.
